head: codex/5874-snapshot-catalog
title: [v0.92][WP-04.12] Snapshot catalog and transfer manifest
body:
## Summary

- add authenticated snapshot catalog entries and target-bound transfer manifests
- require current owner SnapshotSigning authority plus active lease and fencing authority
- verify canonical protobuf, bounded content and chunk digests, redaction, expiry, target binding, and durable replay state

## Validation

- focused nextest: 14 passed, 0 skipped
- strict focused Clippy: passed
- 17 machine-derived negative cases: passed
- exact-revision receipt and producer mapping: passed
- independent exact-head security review: passed

Closes danielbaustin/agent-design-language#5874
